EmailTemplate.name: Core Email notification for lead ownership change
EmailTemplate.subject: New lead assigned to you: {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} has been assigned to you because it has been qualified by an LDR. Prior to this assignment you will have met or otherwise communicated with the responsible LDR to get a high-level overview of the potential opportunity, and have agreed to accept the lead.
Actions upon receipt of this notification:
1. Change sales stage to “Sales Accepted Lead”
a. A call or email must be logged within 1 business day of receipt of this notification
2. If contact established and the lead is considered an opportunity, change sales stage to “Sales Qualified Lead” to convert the lead.
3. If contact cannot be established:
a. Lead status changed to “Unreachable”
If not an opportunity at this time, and if desired, you can convert this lead to a contact for potential contact in the future.
Good Luck!
